$comment: Local-dev HTTP port per Polaris service. THE registry: every other place
that names a port is checked against this file by
Before this existed the ports lived in each package's `dev` script and
were copied by hand into prometheus.yml, the CI workflow and the
observability doc. They had already drifted: Prometheus scraped the
ingester on 8080 while its dev script binds 4000, and six services were
not scraped at all because nobody knew which port to write down.
`bin/dev` reads the ports out of the `dev` scripts at runtime, so those
stay the executable source; the test holds them against this file so the
Services with no entry have no HTTP listener. `traits`, `audiences` and
`reverse-etl` are libraries the CLI invokes -- traits carried a `dev`
script naming itself `sessionizer` on sessionizer-v2's port and pointing
at a `src/main.ts` that does not exist, which is what pure copy-paste
looks like when nothing checks it.
